title: My Matches
subtitle: Everyone you’ve saved, matched with, or who’s shown interest.

shortlist.label: Saved
shortlist.title: Nothing saved yet
shortlist.line: Tap the bookmark on a profile to save it here for later.
shortlist.supply: New Tricity members join every week, so this list grows as the community does.

mutual.label: Mutual
mutual.title: No mutual matches yet
mutual.line: When you and someone both express interest, they show up here.
mutual.supply: A mutual match needs two people. The surest way to get one is to bring someone you already trust into the circle.

sent.label: Sent
sent.title: You haven’t reached out yet
sent.line: Profiles you like show up here. Today’s matches are waiting.
sent.supply: Expressing interest is free, and a thoughtful like is how every mutual match starts.

likes.label: Likes You
likes.title: No interests received yet
likes.line: Members who like you will appear here.
likes.supply: A complete, photo-verified profile gets seen first, and the more Tricity families here, the more eyes on yours.

errorBody: Something went wrong. Give it another try.
premiumBody: Upgrade to Premium to reveal every member who’s already expressed interest in your profile.

endMatch.title: End your match with {{name}}?
endMatch.body: Withdrawing your interest ends the match. Neither of you can message the other until you both like each other again. They are not told.

keptLikeMutual: You're already matched. Find them under Matches → Mutual.
keptLikeSent: Already in your sent interests. Find them under Matches → Sent.
